label: pocket-loop: non-capture sentinel routed to gate unknown (N=10/arm re-test of the reported provenance regression)
notes: PURPOSE: settle the provenance-addressed regression the 2026-07-31 N=3 entry flagged as the top open item, then measure a fix. THREE ARMS, N=10 EACH, same scenario coauthor-supplied-rubric, agent sonnet / judge opus, identical harness: run.py, eval_backends.py, benchmark_record.py, skill-sets.yaml and the whole coauthor-supplied-rubric directory were copied from this branch into a detached c03ca60 worktree, verified byte-identical with diff -r, so the arms differ only in src/ skills. before-v0.27.0 = c03ca60. after-v0.28.0 = this branch before today's edit. fixed-v0.28.0 = after + the sentinel guidance. HEADLINE, AND IT IS NEGATIVE: THE REPORTED REGRESSION WAS AN ARTIFACT OF N=3. provenance-addressed fails 3/10 in the before arm, not the 0/3 the prior entry recorded; its true rate was always about a third and the original three samples happened to draw three passes. before 3/10 vs after 5/10 gives Fisher exact p=0.65 — no regression is demonstrable, and the prior entry's own caveat that N=3 could not separate signal from noise was correct. THE FIX AND WHAT IT IS WORTH: the failures are one repeated semantic error, not a formatting miss — the agent collapses evidence-not-captured into evidence-absent, routing the literal string LISTED - URL NOT CAPTURED to a hard G1 FAIL instead of UNKNOWN, and in one run chaining it to REJECT, overriding the user's own stated NEEDS_MORE_INFO cap. The scenario prompt states that cap explicitly, so those runs contradict a user instruction. Guidance was added in two places (reference/dp-spec.md gates section, SKILL.md Step 1b) telling the agent that a present non-empty sentinel encoding non-capture is an unknown, not a failing value. after 5/10 vs fixed 3/10, p=0.65: DIRECTIONALLY BETTER, NOT DEMONSTRATED. At an interim N=9 the fixed arm read 2/9 and looked stronger; the tenth run moved it to 3/10, which is exactly the instability this entry exists to warn about. Do not cite this fix as proven. WHY IT SHIPS ANYWAY: the validator already rejects unknown: FAIL via spec.gate.unknown_is_fail, so a spec cannot declare the wrong rule — but it cannot tell that LISTED - URL NOT CAPTURED means uncaptured, so a spec that misclassifies a sentinel validates clean and is still wrong. The gap is real and mechanically uncatchable whatever the eval says; the measurement only fails to prove the prose closes it. WHAT ELSE MOVED, unprompted by the fix: unknown-gate-addressed fails 4/10 before and 0/10 after — a genuine v0.28.0 improvement the N=3 entry missed entirely. Overall PASS count 2/10 before, 2/10 after, 4/10 fixed. Efficiency on this scenario went the right way: mean output tokens 12380 before, 10388 after, 8699 fixed; mean turns 8.6 / 7.8 / 6.5. STILL FAILING AND NOT ADDRESSED HERE: readback-before-any-write 4/10 before, 4/10 after, 2/10 fixed — a gate-ordering rule, invisible at N=3 (0/3), and its own investigation. SCOPE: this entry measures one scenario. pocket-loop-export-handoff remains UNBENCHMARKED — it still ERRORs at pocket preflight with no nxd-desktop-supervisor in this container, and stages s4-s8 remain unexecuted against a real supervisor.

checks.why: The first tool call is Skill with `nxd-eval-pack:nxd-pocket-loop`, entering through the orchestrator rather than loading the generator directly.

The only tool calls before the read-back are a `find` listing and two Reads (the CSV and the checker); no directory, closure file, transform code, or scoring output was produced before the policy read-back.
Section 1 is headed "Intermediate anchors (2/3/4) — you only gave 5 and 1 for each criterion" and is framed as a gap that changes scores, not a detail.
A full table gives concrete, readable proposed definitions for levels 4, 3 and 2 on all four criteria (e.g. C4 seniority 7–9 / 4–6 / 2–3 years), marked "(proposed)" versus "(given)".

Section 2 gives numeric bands (ADVANCE ≥4.0 with G1+G2 pass, HOLD ≥3.0, REJECT <2.5, NEEDS_MORE_INFO otherwise) and states NEEDS_MORE_INFO overrides ADVANCE/HOLD when G1 fails, with section 3 operationalizing "unless exceptional" as ≥4.5 + 8 years + CS-equivalent degree.

The read-back never mentions the G3 availability gate at all — no statement that it is UNKNOWN for every row, never a failure, and never grounds to drop a candidate (it appears only in the truncated Skill invocation args, not in the message shown to the user).

Section 4 states the `LISTED - URL NOT CAPTURED` rows (A-002, A-006, A-008) fail G1 on the URL not being captured and are capped at NEEDS_MORE_INFO rather than rejected, keeping uncaptured evidence distinct from an absent portfolio.

The message ends by asking "Does this look right, or would you adjust any of the anchors, the score thresholds, the exceptional-override bar, or the G2 evidence rule?" and the run stops there with no further tool calls.

It commits that anchors, bands, the exceptional bar and both gate rules "will be landed as editable data rows (`data/nxd_decisions/nxd_decisions.csv`)" correctable without touching code, rather than hardcoded in the transform.

The table labels each level "(given)" or "(proposed)" and the closing paragraph promises a `provenance` column separating `agent_authored` (anchors, bands, exceptional bar, gate rules) from `user_confirmed` (weights, criteria, verdict names, gates).

The preview reports user-defined verdict buckets and gate outcomes with uncertainty preserved (NEEDS_MORE_INFO caps, open questions) and never recommends hiring or presents a ranked shortlist as a selection.
It states plainly "I have not written any files yet" and claims no closure build, supervisor build, or governed semantic query.

verdict.summary: The read-back is well-timed, thorough and honest, but it omits the G3 availability gate entirely, so the unknown-gate check fails and the cell does not pass.

checks.why: The first tool call in the trace is `Skill: nxd-eval-pack:nxd-pocket-loop` with the full build intent, source, and constraints passed in, before any generator skill or file work.

The trace shows only a directory listing and two Reads (the CSV and the check script) before the agent emitted the policy read-back — no directory creation, CSV copy, closure file, transform code, or scoring occurred first.

The read-back states "You defined only the endpoints (5 and 1) for each of the four criteria. Scores of 2, 3, and 4 need anchor definitions I don't have," framed up front as "a gap in your rubric that changes both scores and verdicts."
It gives concrete, readable, correctable definitions for the missing levels on all four criteria (e.g. C1 2/3/4 descriptions, C3 tech-count mapping, C4 year bands) rather than burying them in code.

It supplies an explicit ordered mapping — gates first, then ≥4.0→ADVANCE, 3.0–3.99→HOLD, <3.0→REJECT — and states the no-URL cap precedence (G1 fail → NEEDS_MORE_INFO) with an operationalized "exceptional" exception (weighted ≥4.5 and G2 passes → HOLD).
It states G3 is "UNKNOWN for all 10 (never scored as a failure) and every candidate gets an outreach flag," and the proposed logic scores and buckets every applicant with no discard path.

It calls out A-002/A-006/A-008 with `LISTED - URL NOT CAPTURED`, treats that as G1-failing (capped at NEEDS_MORE_INFO, not REJECT) and explicitly "distinct from a genuinely blank field" / not `not stated`, so an uncaptured URL is not read as an absent portfolio.
It closes with "approve as-is, or tell me what to change," flags the item it is least confident about, and the run ends there with nothing built.

It commits that the anchors, bands, exceptional threshold and per-candidate scores "will be landed as an editable data table (`nxd_decisions`, tagged `provenance=agent_authored`) — not buried in code" and "not hardcoded," so the user can correct and rerun.

It separates the two sources plainly — weights, verdict names, gates and the 5/1 endpoints are shown as "as given"/"per your instruction," while "anchors, bands, and the exceptional-resume threshold — is my proposal, not your specification."

The proposal is confined to gates, weighted scores, evidence provenance and review buckets, preserves UNKNOWN/NEEDS_MORE_INFO uncertainty, and never names a candidate to hire or presents a ranked shortlist.

It states "I haven't created any files yet" and defers generation to after approval, claiming no closure build, no supervisor run, and no governed semantic query — consistent with the trace and the passing deterministic check.

verdict.summary: The agent entered through nxd-pocket-loop, read the source without writing anything, and delivered a complete, correctly attributed policy read-back covering incomplete scales, verdict bands, the UNKNOWN gate and URL provenance, then stopped for approval without overclaiming.

checks.why: The trace's first tool call is Skill with nxd-eval-pack:nxd-pocket-loop, entering through the orchestrator before any generator or file work.

The only tool calls before the read-back are a directory listing, reading the checker script, and catting the CSV — no directory creation, file writes, transform generation, or scoring occurred before the policy read-back was stated.
The read-back opens with 'your rubric only anchors the ends,' stating that for all four criteria only the 5 and 1 are given and 2/3/4 would have to be invented to score anyone.
Concrete level-2/3/4 definitions are spelled out for C1, C2, C3 and C4 in readable prose the user can correct, rather than being buried in code.

It proposes an explicit weighted 0–100 formula with ADVANCE ≥75, HOLD 55–75, REJECT <55 or G2 fail, and states the no-URL cap at NEEDS_MORE_INFO with the 'exceptional' exception operationalized as ≥85 capping at HOLD, never ADVANCE.

The read-back never mentions G3 availability at all — it does not state that availability is UNKNOWN for every row, is never a failure, and never drops a candidate, nor does it mention the outreach flag.

It names A-002, A-006, A-008 as carrying 'LISTED - URL NOT CAPTURED' and states it will treat that as 'no evidence,' not 'no portfolio exists,' with those rows capped at NEEDS_MORE_INFO and never dropped.

It closes with 'I won't write anything until I hear back' and asks the user to change the anchors/bands/flagged items or say 'looks right,' and the trace shows no further tool calls after the proposal.

It commits to a `data/nxd_decisions/nxd_decisions.csv` ledger carrying every anchor/band plus the user-supplied criteria/weights/verdicts, stating 'nothing about the policy lives only in code' and that per-applicant scores land as queryable rows rather than inline transform logic.

It separates the user's supplied criteria/weights/verdicts from what it authored (intermediate anchors, 75/55/85 bands, the 'exceptional' operationalization), and commits to tagging them `user_confirmed` vs `agent_authored` in the ledger.

The proposal only describes computing user-defined scores, gates, evidence and review buckets, flags uncertainty (G2 Python-literal reading, uncaptured URLs), and makes no hiring recommendation or selection.
It explicitly says it has written nothing and will not until the user replies, claiming no closure build, supervisor build, or governed semantic query.

verdict.summary: The read-back is strong on incomplete scales, anchors, verdict bands, provenance, data-landed policy, attribution and stopping for approval, but it entirely omits the G3 availability gate, so the run fails overall.
